title: Import old returns
covers: matching it to a client or creating one

steps.say: Bring a client's past returns into {product} - the return as filed, the client record and next year's statement ready to fill.
The ITR JSON as filed - from incometax.gov.in or the offline utility. {product} reads the form, the year, the person and every figure.
The client with the same PAN is picked for you. No such client? Create one from the return - and start this year for them if they have not come yet.
Give the acknowledgement number and the date filed. A revised or updated return takes the place of the one standing; the same return twice is refused.
Download the statement as filed, and next year's statement with last year's figures beside each line - ready to fill and upload.
